jobs.jobDescription:
Product at Nash

The Role

Join Nash, an autonomic logistics platform helping enterprises plan, execute, and manage deliveries across diverse fleets, partners, and networks. As a Product Manager, you’ll be at the heart of shaping innovative logistics solutions powered by advanced AI models and integrations. You’ll drive the product vision, collaborating closely with engineering, design, solutions, and go-to-market teams to solve real-world operational challenges for large enterprises.

Our platform operates in highly complex environments, handling orders, inventory, dispatch decisions, delivery updates, and exception management across customer fleets and third-party systems. As a Product Manager, you will translate these workflow challenges into actionable product development, ensuring our solutions deliver measurable value for enterprise customers.

What You’ll Own

  • Define and execute product strategy for core logistics solutions, aligning with business objectives and customer needs.

  • Collaborate with engineering, design, and solutions teams to design, build, and launch features that integrate seamlessly with enterprise OMS, WMS, TMS, and POS systems.

  • Lead product discovery, gathering insights from customers, internal teams, and market research to identify new opportunities and refine existing features.

  • Own the product lifecycle from concept through launch, including scoping, prioritization, requirements definition, and hands-on validation of technical solutions.

  • Work directly with customers and solutions engineers to develop use cases, validate requirements, and ensure each release delivers real workflow improvements.

  • Build and refine product documentation, enablement materials, and value narratives to support sales, customer success, and go-to-market initiatives.

  • Drive analytics and reporting to measure success, understand customer adoption, and identify areas for continuous improvement.

  • Stay hands-on with the latest AI advancements, rapidly testing new models, agent capabilities, and feature prototypes with real-world customer use cases.

  • Serve as a key product evangelist, representing Nash’s vision with customers, partners, and at industry events.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, logistics, supply chain, or enterprise software.

  • Strong technical acumen with hands-on experience in system integrations, APIs, and complex enterprise environments.

  • Proactive discovery and analytical skills—you ask the right questions, explore unarticulated pain points, and transform ambiguous needs into clear requirements.

  • Exposure to AI tools and models, with an understanding of how cutting-edge tech can drive value in operational workflows.

  • Experience working cross-functionally to lead collaborative product development with engineering, design, and technical sales or solutions teams.

  • Ability to draft clear requirements, user stories, and comprehensive use cases based on structured discovery and customer feedback.

  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to both technical and executive audiences.

  • Ownership mindset—you thrive in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements and can drive initiatives from 0 to 1.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous experience in logistics, delivery, or supply chain technology.

  • Experience shipping AI-native or agent-driven product features.

  • Hands-on data analysis or financial modeling skills to quantify product impact.

  • Flexible PTO and remote-first culture.

More about Nash

Nash is the platform that powers modern logistics.

Commerce has inverted. For decades, customers came to where products and services were. Now products and services come to them, on their terms, in real time. That shift has turned every company into a logistics company, even though almost none of them were built to be one. Couriers, fleets, gig workers, parcel carriers, in-store labor, and increasingly autonomous systems all have to be coordinated in real time, against tighter windows and rising expectations, with hard-fought customer trust on the line.

Nash unifies decisioning, execution, and capacity into a single programmable platform. Real-time, AI-native intelligence determines what should happen, operational control executes it, and the platform dynamically orchestrates capacity from any source: a company's own fleets, partners, or the Nash delivery network. Whether a job involves a courier, a gig driver, an internal fleet, a store employee, a technician, or an autonomous vehicle, Nash selects the right resource and manages execution through completion.

We power delivery and logistics for some of the most recognizable brands in commerce, including Walmart, Urban Outfitters, 7-Eleven, and Woolworths, alongside platforms like Shopify and Toast. Over the next decade, logistics will become as foundational to commerce as payments, cloud, and connectivity. Nash is the platform that powers it.

Nash was founded in 2021 by Mahmoud Ghulman (2x Founder, MIT) and Aziz Alghunaim (2x Founder, 2x YC, Ex-Palantir, MIT) and is backed by Y Combinator, a16z, and other top investors. We are headquartered in San Francisco.

What You’ll Love About Us

✅ Early-stage, well-funded startup – directly impact the company and grow your career!
✅ Quarterly broader team on-sites to bond with teammates
✅ Competitive compensation and opportunity for equity
✅ Flexible paid time off
✅ Health, dental, and vision insurance for US employees

jobs.jobDescription:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

What you’ll do:

This is a 12-month contract role, approximately 40 hours per week. You’ll work closely with our in-house recruiter and broader People team, jumping in wherever you can create the most leverage across our hiring efforts.

Depending on what the team needs in a given week, you might:

  • Build and execute sourcing strategies for technical and non-technical searches, identifying and engaging high-caliber talent

  • Conduct candidate outreach and help nurture promising candidates through the recruiting process

  • Support interview scheduling and coordination, helping keep processes moving quickly and smoothly

  • Step into recruiter screens or other candidate conversations as needed

  • Partner with hiring managers and interview teams on searches, candidate pipelines, and recruiting priorities

  • Help keep candidates informed and deliver a thoughtful, high-touch experience throughout the process

  • Maintain strong data hygiene in our ATS and recruiting tools

  • Pitch in on recruiting projects, research, process improvements, or other priorities as they arise

This role is intentionally broad. We’re a small, fast-moving team, and we’re looking for someone who is comfortable moving between strategic recruiting work and the important operational details that keep hiring running smoothly.

You will be a match if:

  • You have 7+ years of recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology environment, and can quickly step into a search or recruiting workflow with minimal ramp-up or oversight.

  • You’re an experienced recruiter who is equally comfortable sourcing candidates, talking with hiring managers, engaging candidates, and handling the details that keep a process moving

  • You’re a strong sourcer who enjoys uncovering hard-to-find talent and finding creative ways to build high-quality pipelines

  • You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments and don’t need a narrowly defined lane to do your best work

  • You take a thoughtful, data-informed approach to recruiting and maintain a high bar for accuracy and follow-through

  • You care deeply about candidate experience and communicate with warmth, clarity, and professionalism

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills

You might be a good fit if:

  • You’ve recruited for both technical and non-technical roles (engineering, product, data, marketing, sales, finance, etc)

  • You have experience in a consumer technology environment

  • You’ve worked at an early- or mid-stage startup and enjoy the variety that comes with a smaller team

  • You have full-cycle recruiting experience but are genuinely happy flexing across sourcing, coordination, candidate management, and other recruiting needs

[1] Some more context:

(If you are on LinkedIn, you will not be able to access the hyperlinks below. Once you click apply, you will be directed to our career website (if you are not on there already) and will be able to access the hyperlinks)

  • How ClassDojo Connects Parents, Students, and Teachers

  • “Whats New on ClassDojo 2023”

  • TechCrunch Article: Second Act comes with First Profits

Click here if you're interested in learning more about what we've been up to.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are happy to accommodate any disabilities or special needs. We are a distributed company, so we hire regardless of location, as long as you are willing to have significant hours overlap with one of the Americas time zones.

ClassDojo takes a number of factors into consideration when determining final contract rates, including geographic location, experience, and skillset. Hourly rate ranges (United States):

CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT states: $50 - $75 / hr (USD)

All other states in the US: $45 - $62.50 / hr (USD)

jobs.jobDescription:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US), with travel about once a month
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Head of Higher Ed
Compensation: $110,000 to $150,000 per year

More than 50 colleges and universities offer CodePath courses for credit, taught by their own faculty or by CodePath. For a student, a seat in one of those courses means industry-vetted learning and career support built into the degree they're already earning. The courses only change outcomes if students know they exist and sign up.

That's your job. Students find us through a professor who mentions the course before registration opens, an advisor who forwards a note, a club event, or a friend who took the course last term. Most of that reach happens through people on campus, so your work is making it easy for faculty, advisors, career services, club leaders, alumni, and Tech Fellows to carry the message for us. You'll build all of it: the toolkits and campaigns they share, the campus presence, and the student community that recruits the next cohort. You'll be measured on how many students enroll and stay through add/drop, because each filled seat is one more student getting the training we exist to provide.

You'll be a dedicated partner to our Higher Education partnerships team, who own the relationships with faculty and campus leadership, and you'll own the student side of every partner campus. Some weeks that means building a one-pager a department chair can forward on Monday, tuning an email sequence on a Wednesday, and representing CodePath at a hackathon on Friday. You'll be building this function from the ground up and you need to decide in advance how we show up and what we expect back.

What you'll own

Partner activation and campaign development

  • Build and run a term playbook for each for-credit partner, from awareness through add/drop
  • Equip faculty, advisors, career services, and club leaders to market CodePath courses with toolkits, talking points, and assets they can forward
  • Turn national for-credit applicants into enrolled students: find where they drop off and test what moves conversion
  • Run virtual info sessions and campus landing pages that end with a clear path to register
  • Own email and SMS to opted-in students: build the list, run the campaigns, and work with our lifecycle contractor so campus and direct touches land as one sequence

Student community building

  • Design how alumni, Tech Fellows, and instructors show up on campus and engage students, and build the online side of that community (Discord and similar)
  • Own relationships with student clubs, CS and AI organizations, hackathon organizers, and campus chapters of national organizations like ColorStack, NSBE, and SHPE
  • Plan the event calendar a term ahead, with a clear standard for which events we do and what each should return

Measurement

  • Tie every sign-up to a channel and a partner, test timing, message, and channel, and move time and budget to what works
  • Use AI to run the playbook at 50+ campuses without adding headcount: toolkits per campus, calendars and send dates, results in one view

What success looks like in your first year

  • Every partner runs a term playbook, and fill rate and melt improve at for-credit partners
  • National for-credit conversion is measurably higher
  • Every new partner launches with a full first section
  • A student advocate network is live at our largest partners
  • The opted-in student list grows, and every sign-up traces to a channel

This role may be right for you if

  • You've owned an enrollment, sign-up, or acquisition number and moved it. You set up the tracking and can show which efforts drove the result
  • You've gotten partners to market on your behalf: individuals who carried your message because you made it easy for them, and you can show what it produced
  • You've built a campus, ambassador, or community program from the ground up and can show what it produced
  • You’ve built campaigns from concept to launch, including copy and creative, and run email or SMS to a list you built, changing them based on the numbers
  • You've decided where to spend time and money (events, channels, sponsorships) based on expected return, and cut what didn't deliver
  • You've run a program across many sites at once (campuses, chapters, regions) on a fixed calendar, and kept it on schedule without a team under you
  • You’ve built AI into how you work to automate the repetitive parts, and you can show what it changed
  • You want your growth work to widen who gets into tech careers

Bonus

  • Experience in enrollment or admissions marketing in higher education
  • You’ve built or scaled a technical community (a student developer org, hackathon community, Discord, or dev rel program) and can show how it grew
  • Hands-on HubSpot experience
  • You're comfortable speaking at events and on panels on behalf of CodePath

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position's level, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring for a Senior Manager level position at an annual salary of $110,000 to $150,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support
  • ​​Student Loan Forgiveness: CodePath is a qualifying employer for Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), helping employees manage student loan debt
  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

Pay range

$110,000—$150,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Bags and Accessories)

We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Manager, Global Procurement (Bags and Accessories) to own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.

Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.
    • Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
    • Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
    • Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.
  • RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.
    • Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
    • Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.
  • Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.
    • Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished GoodsManufacturers Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) New categories / new products
    • Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
    • Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
    • Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)
  • Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.
  • Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.
    • e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

Qualifications

Required:

  • 12-15 years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in a consumer goods or retail environment
  • Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
  • Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
  • Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$164,000—$240,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

We seek an energetic, optimistic, curious, and empathetic coach and leader to manage a growing team of Enterprise Solution Engineers across the US West, driving the next wave of customer outcomes.

As Director, Sales Engineering in the US West, you will:

  • Lead a team of trusted advisors who are responsible for demonstrating the value of Dataiku’s AI and Agent Management platforms.
  • Partner with the sales organisation to earn new and retain existing Dataiku clients by championing and delivering AI-enabled business strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across product, marketing, sales, customer success, and others to align on AI native go-to-market motions.
  • Mentor your team; hire and retain top talent with a strong focus on balancing tech and sales expertise.

You'll be successful in this role if you can:

  • Coach sales engineers on Dataiku’s evolving product value, competitive differentiation, and the application of the Challenger Sales methodology.
  • Serve as a player/coach to engage on high-profile customer opportunities, providing a strategic lens and elevating delivery.
  • Serve as a technical point of contact for sales leadership; communicate technical risks and opportunities faced in sales engagements
  • Mentor team members; host regular check-ins, provide career guidance, and hire and scale the team.
  • Build strong working relationships with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment on delivering customer outcomes.
  • Communicate directly with sales leadership to strategise around adoption and expansion.
  • Host enablement sessions focusing on the latest in technology trends.
  • Partner with the Sales Engineering leadership to refine key performance indicators for your team.

You could be a good fit if you have:

  • At least five years of experience in sales engineering.
  • At least two years of people management experience, including a passion for building and hiring teams.
  • Experience in complex/large-scale enterprise AI and analytics deployments.
  • Deep understanding of the AI landscape, including foundation models, LLMOps, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and autonomous AI agents.
  • Experience building and enabling high-performing technical teams in a rapidly evolving AI market.
  • Demonstrated intellectual curiosity regarding the intersection of business, traditional machine learning, and Agentic AI technologies.

Other preferred qualifications:

  • Proficiency in programming languages (Python, R, SQL, Java, etc.).
  • Experience with cloud services and their respective AI/ML services (AWS Bedrock, Azure Foundry, GCP Vertex AI, etc.).
  • Understanding of the modern AI lifecycle, including LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic orchestration, alongside the traditional machine learning lifecycle (feature engineering, model training, model deployment).
  • Knowledge of machine learning and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.
  • Experience driving AI Native GTM transformations
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to demystify complex AI concepts for executive audiences.

Compensation and Benefits

The final compensation package for this role will be determined during the interview process and is based on a variety of factors, including, but not limited to, geographic location, internal equity, education, skill set, experience and training. Eligible roles may also be entitled to receive commission or other variable compensation through Dataiku's incentive compensation program.

Dataiku also offers comprehensive benefits, including stock options, medical, dental, and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, pre-tax commuter benefits, a 401k company match, paid vacations and sick leave, paid parental leave, employer paid disability coverage, and additional health and wellbeing perks and benefits. Dataiku reserves the right to amend or modify employee perks and benefits at any time.

US only national base pay ranges

$187,000—$234,000 USD

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our Mission

Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve.

About Brain Co.

Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model.

Why Now

Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services.

Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact.

You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now.

About the Role

As our Security Engineer, Application & AI, you will own the security of our products and application layer — secure development practices, agent security, third-party integration security, and data protection for AI products operating in some of the world's most regulated and sensitive environments.

This is a hands-on builder role. You will write code, ship security tooling, and work directly with product and ML engineers to build security in from the start rather than bolt it on after. You are expected to work AI-natively: using AI to write threat models, automate security review, scale code analysis, and build internal tooling. This is not a nice-to-have — it is how the role is designed to operate and how one person can have outsized impact across a fast-moving engineering organization.

Brain Co.'s products are built on agentic infrastructure — AI that takes actions, calls tools, and operates inside complex institutional workflows. The degree varies by product, but the underlying security surface is consistent: how agents are authorized, what they can touch, and how that is controlled at the application layer. This role is specifically designed to address that surface, working alongside the Infrastructure Security Engineer who owns the platform layer underneath.

What You'll Work On

Application Security

  • Own secure development practices across our products: AuthN/AuthZ patterns, secrets management, input handling, and secure-by-default standards that engineers can follow without security becoming a bottleneck.

  • Integrate security into the development lifecycle — code review, CI/CD pipelines, and pre-deployment checks — catching risk before it reaches production.

  • Conduct threat modeling across product features and release cycles, translating risk into concrete controls that ship alongside each product.

  • Build and maintain security tooling and automated checks that scale your reach across the codebase — using AI to move faster and cover more ground than manual review alone could.

Agent & Integration Security

  • Own the application-layer security model for Brain Co.'s agentic products — how agents are scoped, what they are authorized to do on behalf of users, and where trust boundaries sit between the agent and the external systems it touches.

  • Define secure patterns for how agents integrate with third-party systems and APIs: how credentials are stored and scoped, how responses are validated before being acted on, and how each product limits what agents can do with what they get back.

  • Work directly with product and ML engineers during feature development to define secure agent design patterns: tool scoping, permission boundaries, output validation, and safe handling of user context across multi-step workflows.

  • Build reusable secure-by-default patterns for agent development — design guidelines, review checklists, and code-level guardrails — so that security standards scale as new agent capabilities are built.

  • Produce security artifacts for agent features and product deployments: threat models, architecture reviews, and documentation that supports delivery into regulated customer environments.

Data Protection

  • Define and enforce data protection standards at the application layer — ensuring sensitive customer data (PHI, PII, government records) is handled correctly as it flows through AI pipelines and surfaces in agent outputs.

  • Build safeguards against unauthorized data exposure across our products: access controls, output filtering, and audit logging that make data handling attributable and reviewable.

  • Design secure data handling patterns for AI features operating on regulated data, working with platform and ML teams to ensure the application layer upholds its share of the data protection contract.

You Might Be a Great Fit If You...

  • Have 5+ years of experience in application security or product security, with hands-on experience on production systems at scale.

  • Are a builder first — you write code and ship security tooling, and see embedding security into the engineering workflow as the job, not a side effect of it.

  • Have deep fluency in application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, AuthN/AuthZ, secure SDLC, secrets management, secure integration patterns, and cryptography basics.

  • Understand the security surface of agentic AI across the product layer — how agents should be designed, scoped, and reviewed for risk — and can work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers to build those standards in.

  • Have experience protecting sensitive data at the application layer: access controls, audit logging, and preventing data exposure through third-party integrations and AI-generated outputs.

  • Work AI-natively — you already use AI to write better code, move faster, and do more with less, and you bring that same instinct to security work.

  • Think in attack surfaces and trust boundaries and can move cleanly from threat model to concrete shipped control.

  • Are comfortable working alongside delivery teams shipping into regulated industries, understanding their constraints and translating them into product-level security requirements.

  • Thrive in high-agency environments and want to own and grow the application security function as the company scales.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with agent security, LLM application security, or building authorization and guardrail systems for agentic pipelines.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to government and healthcare: FedRAMP, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001.

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or TypeScript for security tooling and automation.

  • Experience with SAST/DAST tooling or integrating automated security checks into developer workflows at scale.

Why Join Us

  • Define what application and AI security looks like at a company building frontier AI for governments, hospitals, and critical industries — from the ground up.

  • Work directly alongside product and ML teams shipping agentic AI into some of the world's most demanding institutional environments.

  • Build the security function AI-natively — using the same technology you're helping secure to scale your own work and impact.

  • Work alongside senior engineers from Tesla, DeepMind, Databricks, and other top engineering organizations.

  • Ship fast, learn constantly, and see your work protect production systems used by millions of people.

  • Earn competitive compensation and meaningful equity in a high-growth company.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary plus equity

  • Daily lunches

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision

  • Unlimited PTO

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the Role

CertiK’s security consulting team helps blockchain projects and institutions secure their smart contracts, applications, and Web3 infrastructure. We are looking for a Project Manager to manage the delivery of security engagements and keep clients, security engineers, sales and internal teams aligned from kickoff through final report delivery.

In this role, you will oversee timelines, maintain project documentation, and serve as the primary point of contact for clients across multiple engagements. You will track progress, follow up on outstanding actions, and keep stakeholders informed to ensure engagements are delivered on time and to a high standard, while providing a smooth client experience.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate the full lifecycle of security engagements, including kickoff, timeline planning, milestone tracking, report delivery, and closure.
  • Coordinate with security engineers, sales and other internal teams to confirm project requirements and ensure smooth handoffs at each stage.
  • Identify and escalate project risks such as delays or scope changes, follow through to ensure timely resolution and help refine delivery processes over time.
  • Maintain regular communication with clients, providing status updates, confirming timelines and managing change requests.
  • Lead client meetings such as kickoff calls and report reviews, support security engineers in presenting findings and remediation recommendations, and coordinate follow-up assessments and retests.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of project management experience, with at least 1 year in the blockchain industry.
  • Solid understanding of smart contracts, blockchain security, penetration testing and the ability to discuss technical issues with both security engineers and clients.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple projects simultaneously and coordinating work across multiple teams.
  • Experience in client-facing project roles, with strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed teams across multiple time zones.
  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a cybersecurity industrials, particularly in security consulting or assessment delivery.
  • Familiarity with the broader Web3 ecosystem, including major blockchains and DeFi protocols.
  • Experience working with institutional clients, including financial institutions and enterprises.
  • Proficiency in additional languages, such as Mandarin, Spanish, or Portuguese.

Compensation

Additional Information

The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $90,000 to $120,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

Hims & Hers is seeking an experienced Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team. The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, skilled storyteller, and expert influencer with the demonstrated ability to drive consensus across Product Management, Creative, Acquisition, and Retention teams. This individual will synthesize customer insights and data to drive go-to-market strategies and product adoption. In this role, this individual will build upon their understanding of consumers’ healthcare needs to optimize our existing offering and drive updates to better meet customer needs. Strong communication skills will be important, and this person will be able to confidently share strategies that educate and inspire internal and external partners at all levels.

This is a temporary position for 6 months.

You Will:

  • Champion the voice of the customer to prioritize products and experiences to best address consumers’ healthcare needs

  • Operate in a highly cross-functional role, partnering closely with Product/Engineering, Category Management, Integrated Marketing, Creative, Brand, Growth Marketing, Insights, and Product Development to scale the offering

  • Collaborate with Product Management, Design, and Analytics to shape digital customer experiences that drive conversion, engagement, and retention

  • Lead identification of the right segmentation, positioning, messaging, and adoption tactics for new and existing products in focus area(s)

  • Develop differentiated product/feature positioning and messaging informed by customer insights, market trends, and competitive analysis

  • Develop thoughtful go-to-market strategies and briefs anchored in customer insights and an understanding of competitive/macro landscape

  • Drive experimentation strategy in partnership with Product Management, Design, Acquisition, and Lifecycle teams to optimize efforts

  • Lead complex workstreams and/or product segments with minimal oversight

  • Own end-to-end work across multiple categories and product lines

You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in marketing; 5+ of those years in product marketing specifically (or similar roles like GTM, consumer marketing, or integrated marketing strategy)

  • Strong storyteller with the ability to develop campaigns that get customers’ attention and build product brands people love

  • Ability to drive experimentation focused on conversion and engagement

  • Analytical thinker with experience in data-driven marketing

  • Experience using insights and strategic thinking to influence stakeholders and the product roadmap

  • Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams

  • Team player who is accountable, proactive, and solution-oriented

  • Experience communicating the benefits of various marketing strategies to business audiences of all levels, including C-suite

  • Experience driving complex projects in a fast-paced environment

  • Consumer product marketing experience is a strong plus

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Psychology, or related field, or equivalent work experience. An MBA or a Master's in marketing/communications is a plus

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@forhims.com and describe the needed accommodation. Your privacy is important to us, and any information you share will only be used for the legitimate purpose of considering your request for accommodation. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address.

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

The ideal candidate will have a track record of over-quota achievement and will grow an ambitious pipeline of business. Remote - Western Time Zone

  • Create measurable and defined business goals with timelines, (related to revenue and growth of whitespace)

jobs.jobDescription:
Are you a BCBA looking for the flexibility of remote work without giving up clinical impact? At Centria Autism, our Telehealth BCBAs lead in-home ABA services virtually—partnering with families and technicians to bring compassionate, high-quality care directly into clients’ homes.

Whether you’re balancing location needs, family priorities, or a new phase of life, Centria’s virtual model gives you the support and tools to stay connected, effective, and fulfilled in your role.

Criteria for the Telehealth BCBA role includes periodic travel to the market (travel expenses paid by Centria!).

Compensation & Incentives – Earn a base salary of $83,000–$90,000, plus weekly and monthly bonus opportunities (typically averaging $1,000/month).

What Centria Offers:

  • Flexible, Purposeful Work – Work from home while leading in-home ABA services across multiple locations, ensuring access to care for families in need.
  • Tech That Works for You – Our proprietary CareConnect platform makes remote supervision, programming, documentation, and progress monitoring seamless and intuitive.

  • Assent-Based Care, Anywhere – Support in-home teams using Practical Functional Assessment, Skills-Based Treatment, and assent-based practices, delivered in natural environments that support generalization.
  • Real Work-Life Balance – Predictable caseloads, manageable schedules, and dedicated support teams mean no last-minute chaos and no burnout.
  • You're Never Alone – With layered support from Clinical Directors, Area Clinical Directors, and our Clinical Excellence Team, you'll always have someone in your corner.
  • No Operational Headaches – We handle the logistics. From scheduling to onboarding of technicians, our operations team keeps everything running smoothly behind the scenes.
  • Career Growth on Your Terms – Whether you're mentoring the next generation of BCBAs, leading clinical training, or stepping into leadership, we support your growth.
  • We Invest in You – From CEU stipends and paid CEU days to exclusive internal training events, we’re serious about keeping you sharp—and helping you level up.
  • Perks That Actually Matter – Annual, all-inclusive vacation for two, early wage access, a company car or mileage reimbursement, and full benefits.
  • No Non-Compete – We don’t believe in holding people back. If we’re not the right long-term fit, you’ll still leave better prepared for your next step.

Your Role & Impact as a BCBA

  • Deliver high-quality clinical oversight for in-home ABA services via telehealth
  • Provide remote coaching, supervision, and support to Behavior Technicians in the field
  • Develop and implement assent-based, individualized behavior plans following ABA principles
  • Lead virtual family training sessions to reinforce strategies and drive consistency
  • Maintain high-quality clinical services through regular supervision and data-driven decision-making

At Centria, you’re not just a BCBA - you’re a clinical leader, a mentor, and a changemaker. If you’re ready to grow your career without sacrificing your values, apply today and join a team that invests in your clinical excellence!

Centria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
CodePath is the largest educator of college computer science students in the country. We've trained over 50,000 students from more than 1,000 universities. Our partners include Amazon, Google, and other leading technology companies. After nearly a decade of training technical talent, we launched a $150M initiative with Anthropic to prepare people for careers in AI.

We're expanding into new markets and growing our team as AI changes the workforce. People joining CodePath now will help shape this next stage of our work.

We believe technical skills create opportunities. Our goal is to train millions of learners and create lasting economic impact. If you want to build something new, take ownership, and see the results of your work, this is a place to do it.

About the Role

Location: Remote (US)
Role Type: Full-Time
Reporting to: Director, Partnerships
Compensation: $85,000 - $110,000 annually

CodePath’s Philanthropy Partnerships team raises the philanthropic capital behind the courses, career support, and career outcomes of our students. The Partner Engagement and Communications Manager turns CodePath’s impact into action. You’ll equip the team with compelling stories, visual communications, donor experiences, and campaigns that help funders understand the difference their partnership makes and inspire them to deepen their investment. The role owns a portfolio spanning fundraising collateral and asset management, cultivation and stewardship events, and seasonal fundraising, including end-of-year giving.

This is a highly autonomous building role that combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution. You’ll lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through execution, and build the systems, templates, and AI-enabled workflows that make recurring fundraising communications faster and more consistent. Success requires moving quickly in a fast-paced, evolving organization, translating data and stories into compelling visual communications, and continuously improving how the team plans and executes events and campaigns.

Key Activities

External engagement and events (~60%)

  • Own strategy and execution for key cultivation and stewardship events, designing experiences that deepen donor engagement and advance priority fundraising opportunities, including positioning, contact lists, attendance tracking, and logistics
  • Lead event content and program development, including speaker points, donor experience, and run of show, working with Philanthropy Partnerships and cross-functional teams to ensure engagement outcomes
  • Own donor thought leadership projects such as joint PR, announcements, op-eds, panels, and special events; collaborate with our PR firm, internal marketing team, and the Office of the CEO to execute
  • Serve as the on-the-ground lead at key events, representing the Philanthropy Partnerships team in person and overseeing day-of execution (presentation decks, leave-behinds, signage, run of show)
  • Partner with other departments, including the Office of the CEO, to lead and streamline preparation for key events (messaging alignment, attendance tracking)
  • Capture stories, photography, video, and other event content to repurpose across future cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising communications
  • Research and recommend conferences and external engagement opportunities based on their potential to expand CodePath’s network, strengthen relationships, and generate new fundraising opportunities

Fundraising communications and asset development (~30%)

  • Build, maintain, and frequently update a shared library of polished, reusable visual and narrative assets, including one-pagers, pitch decks, program description templates, proof-point graphics, and boilerplate visuals
  • Identify, develop, and package student stories and impact narratives into fundraising assets that strengthen donor understanding of CodePath’s impact
  • Keep the asset library current as programs, outcomes data, and impact metrics evolve, in collaboration with the Grant Writer
  • Develop scalable design templates, brand systems, and AI-enabled asset-creation workflows that increase the team’s capacity to produce high-quality communications
  • Ensure all assets are on-brand and consistent with CodePath’s visual identity
  • Maintain an editorial calendar and refresh cycle so fundraisers have timely, relevant assets for priority opportunities
  • Project-manage CodePath’s annual report, including partnering with designers, managing funder outreach and clearance, sourcing student stories, and writing targeted sections. This work runs well above 30% in Q1 2027 and tapers as the report is finalized

End-of-year and online giving (~10%)

  • Lead end-of-year giving and other seasonal campaigns end to end, including audience strategy, messaging, digital integration, and project management
  • Own campaign performance across landing pages, email, digital assets, and fundraising platforms, using engagement and giving data to optimize
  • Monitor website and online donations, and identify opportunities to move digital donors toward deeper engagement and larger gifts
  • Develop targeted outreach and campaign messaging that motivates giving and strengthens donors’ connection to CodePath’s mission
  • Analyze campaign and donor data to improve future campaigns and convert one-time or smaller online donors into more engaged supporters

Key Success Metrics

At 30 days

  • Understands CodePath’s core narrative, program model, impact, and active funder portfolio, and how communications and events support donor engagement
  • Has assessed the existing asset library and identified key gaps and priorities
  • Knows the upcoming cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising calendar and the major initiatives needing communications or event support
  • Is familiar with the annual report process, including scope, timeline, stakeholders, and responsibilities

At 60 days

  • Owns a shared editorial and asset-refresh calendar so fundraisers have timely materials for priority opportunities
  • Is contributing high-quality assets against live fundraising needs
  • Independently owns at least one cultivation or stewardship event from planning through execution, with clear engagement objectives
  • Has established reusable templates and workflows for high-volume asset types
  • Has built effective working relationships with the Office of the CEO, Marketing, and frontline fundraisers
  • Independently manages annual report workstreams against the production timeline

At 90 days

  • The shared asset library is current and in active use across the Philanthropy Partnerships team
  • Has led at least one cultivation or stewardship event through execution and follow-up, with evidence it met its engagement objectives
  • Has launched, or is executing, a seasonal giving campaign with a clear audience strategy, messaging, and coordinated digital experience
  • Has implemented at least two repeatable or AI-enabled asset workflows that reduce manual effort or increase team capacity
  • Consistently delivers communications and asset requests on agreed timelines
  • Uses engagement, event, and campaign data to inform improvements to future work

Qualifications

Required

  • Demonstrated commitment to CodePath’s mission, vision, and core values
  • 6–10 years of experience in external communications and/or event planning, preferably with institutional and corporate funders or foundations
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to build repeatable workflows or assets that improve efficiency and quality
  • Strong visual design skills (layout, typography, color, composition), with fluency in a design tool such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or Figma
  • Ability to translate data and narrative into clear, compelling visual storytelling
  • Sharp eye for brand consistency, polish, and detail across materials and formats
  • Comfortable both setting strategic direction (event positioning, campaign approach) and turning others’ source content into polished execution
  • Strong project management skills across concurrent requests and deadlines
  • Able to lead complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives from concept through execution with a high degree of autonomy
  • Collaborates effectively with writers, fundraisers, and program teams
  • Adaptable to fast turnarounds and shifting priorities
  • Continuous-improvement mindset: documents and streamlines recurring work to free time for higher-value strategic and creative tasks

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Design, or Communications
  • Fluency in HubSpot (reporting, customization, outreach, analysis)
  • Experience with Asana or other project management platforms

Compensation

CodePath has standardized salaries based on the position’s level, no matter where you live. For this role, we’re hiring for a Manager-level position at an annual salary of $85,000 to $110,000. Salary is determined based on your relevant experience and skills as evaluated through our interview process.

Full-Time Employee Benefits

This is a remote position—work from anywhere in the US! CodePath prioritizes employee well-being with a competitive benefits package to support your health, financial security, and work-life balance.

  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance (90% employer-covered for employees and dependents), employer-funded healthcare reimbursement, FSAs, and Employee Assistance Program
  • Financial Security: 401(k), employer-paid life & disability insurance, and identity theft protection
  • Work-Life Balance: Generous PTO, paid holidays, 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave, and an annual year-end company closure (Dec 24 – Jan 2)
  • Professional Growth: $1,000 annual professional development stipend and home office setup support

  • Additional Perks: Pet wellness plans, legal services, home/auto insurance discounts, and exclusive marketplace savings

$85,000—$110,000 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Regional Sales Lead, Midwest

As Regional Sales Lead for Quince’s Midwest territory, you will drive $8-figure growth while building and coaching a high-performing team of 5-12 Account Executives. This is a rare “player-coach” role: you’ll spend your time architecting regional strategy at 30,000 feet while rolling up your sleeves to help close complex enterprise deals. You’ll combine tactical enterprise grit with the leadership intuition necessary to build a world-class sales culture—all while operating in a fast-paced, startup environment where the bar is high and ownership is expected from day one.

Your region spans 14 Midwest states: IA, IL, IN, KS, MI, MN, MO, ND, NE, NM, OK, SD, TX, and WI.

Responsibilities

  • Coach and mentor a team of 5-12 Account Executives, focusing on professional development, tactical closing skills, and performance accountability
  • Lead recruitment and onboarding for the Midwest region, owning full team integration through 30/60/90-day benchmarks
  • Run high-energy weekly standups, 1:1s, and regional offsites; set the pace and standard for excellence
  • Own the regional revenue target by identifying high-value enterprise opportunities and driving net-new pipeline through proactive engagement
  • Join key client meetings and industry events to provide executive presence, navigate complex procurement cycles, and help close deals
  • Maintain “source of truth” integrity in HubSpot; oversee pipeline hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and real-time reporting dashboards
  • Develop, manage, and grow your own book of business alongside your team’s growth
  • Be the ultimate subject matter expert on Quince’s B2B model, product assortment, and customization capabilities for both clients and your team
  • Constantly iterate on sales playbooks, tech stacks, and team infrastructure to remove friction and accelerate the sales cycle
  • Proactively identify opportunities for regional expansion and creative positioning within the segment

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of enterprise sales experience with a proven track record of consistently hitting $5M+ annual quotas
  • 3+ years of direct people management experience leading high-performing sales teams
  • Power-user of CRMs (HubSpot preferred) with ability to maintain pipeline integrity and leverage data for strategy
  • Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced startup environments while maintaining rigor and accountability
  • Excellent proactive, solution-oriented problem-solving skills and flexibility
  • Strong verbal and written communication with demonstrated ability to communicate effectively across levels
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace

Preferred:

  • Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up
  • Background in corporate gifting, promotional products, or apparel sales (ASI, PPAI)
  • Familiarity with AI tools for prospecting, research, and outreach
  • Track record of successful talent development and AE promotion from within

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

Pay Range

$230,000—$275,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

jobs.jobDescription:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We’re trusted by 20,000 leading organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

In both our product and our workplace, we’re intentional about making work more efficient, flexible, and fulfilling. Tremendous is a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life.

Our customers, who include researchers, marketers, HR teams, and nonprofits, rave about how fast and easy it is to use Tremendous. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Join us before our next international offsite.

About the role

We're looking for a GTM Engineer focused on marketing who can integrate LLMs, workflow tools, and low-code capabilities to build agentic solutions that automate the highest-leverage workflow problems our marketing team faces. This role will work alongside our brand, content, product marketing, paid, and events marketing teams.

What you'll do

  • Design and build agentic workflows across the full campaign lifecycle, from Product Marketing to Design and Content to Demand Generation.

  • Evaluate and deploy AI tools for marketing. Run structured pilots, then operationalize what works from campaign ideation to execution and analysis.

  • Work with the Data team to build automated reporting pipelines that aggregate cross-channel marketing performance across paid, organic, email, and event channels into a unified view.

  • Build AI-assisted lead scoring and qualification with the marketing planner.

  • Let marketers run channel work from AI agents: paid campaign optimizations, creative uploads, and lifecycle campaign setup in HubSpot.

  • Build reusable tools and workflows that marketers can run themselves. Make the whole team faster rather than becoming a bottleneck.

What you'll bring

  • 5-8 years in marketing operations, marketing technology, or GTM engineering. You understand campaign lifecycles and channel reporting because you've lived them.

  • You build the zero-to-one. Workflows stitched across tools where the inputs are messy and the judgment calls are real, rather than maintained applications on a custom code base.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, AI agent frameworks, and workflow automation tools (Cargo, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar). You've shipped agentic workflows, not just experimented with them.

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and basic scripting. You don't stop when the no-code tool runs out of options.

  • Process-first thinker. Your instinct is to map the workflow and find where it breaks before naming the tool that fixes it.

  • Bias for rapid experimentation. Launch, measure, iterate weekly.

  • Strong written communication. We're a documentation-first culture.

  • Autonomous and self-directed. Tremendous is not a great fit for people who default to waiting for instructions.

  • High empathy. You care about your teammates and users.

Nice to haves

  • Marketing-specific AI tools (Writer, AirOps, Phrase, etc.)

  • SaaS martech stacks (HubSpot, Salesforce, CDPs, ABM platforms)

  • SQL and Snowflake for reporting pipelines

  • Brand or creative operations background. You understand how designers work and what makes a good brief.

  • Cursor, Claude, or similar AI-assisted development tools

What's cool about the role

  • Immediate, measurable impact. The problems are concrete and the wins are visible in weeks.

  • The team is already AI-forward. Cursor daily, monthly AI tool evaluations, leadership fully bought in.

  • Profitable and growing without outside investors.

  • Competitive pay, equity, and benefits. Base salary: $135,000 to $180,000.

  • We're a fully remote company. This role is US Remote.

  • We've got smart people and a great culture. See our company handbook.
