jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

As a Principal Partner Solution Consultant, you will own the relationship with Cresta’s Partners and work with the internal Partner Team to help showcase and enable the power of Cresta to both partners and potential mutual customers. This role is critical to the long-term growth of Cresta, where we view partnerships as a primary way to scale growth and customer base.

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of partnerships, product, and go-to-market teams, ensuring that partners are enabled, technically equipped, and positioned to successfully deliver joint solutions to customers. Success in this role means acting as a trusted advisor for our partners and guiding them toward investing in and building a Cresta partner program.

The ideal candidate for this role thrives in customer-facing roles, thinks strategically about how to solve complex industry challenges using the Cresta platform, and takes ownership of internal and external obstacles.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Expertise and Guidance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and platform expert, connecting technical capabilities to strategic business outcomes for partners and customers.
  • Connect the dots between platform functionality and the outcomes it can drive for partners and their end customers
  • Drive partner success through executive presentations, solution demonstrations, strategic asset creation, and technical presales support.
  • Create and deliver executive-ready presentations that translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes, adapting messaging and depth for partner, customer, and executive stakeholders

Go-to-Market & Revenue Acceleration

  • Develop scalable messaging, enablement content, and solution frameworks that accelerate partner-led revenue growth.
  • Lead strategic solution design discussions and serve as the escalation point for complex partner opportunities, technical challenges, and product feedback.
  • Directly support the partnerships sales team by collaborating on individual partner opportunities to provide tactical guidance

Partner Strategy and Enablement

  • Cultivate trusted relationships with strategic partners including GSIs, BPOs, and technology partners
  • Collaborate with potential and existing partner relationships to provide direct support through strategic platform guidance and solving tactical challenges
  • Help enable partners on value proposition, solution capabilities, and technical positioning for current and future products
  • Contribute to scalable partner solution frameworks, best practices, and enablement assets that increase partner self-sufficiency and accelerate joint customer success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Influence and align stakeholders across Partner Sales, Direct Sales, Partner Enablement, Product, and Solution Engineering to execute and scale Cresta's partner strategy.
  • Work closely with the Partnerships team to continuously identify challenges, recommend solutions, and improve Cresta's partner program and offerings
  • Stay connected in a fast-paced environment that continuously changes product capabilities and roadmap, competitive landscape and strategy, and best practices to maximize our success as a company

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, including 5+ years in technical pre-sales within high-growth SaaS or AI environments.
  • 5+ years of experience working in the Contact Center space
  • Experience working with ISV, SI, and BPO partners in SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop deep platform expertise and engage effectively with both technical and executive audiences.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in New York, NY to join our team and help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You'll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you're equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why This Role Matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We're building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you'll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What You'll Do

  • Make content — Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials — Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase — Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You'll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community — Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company — Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You Might Be a Good Fit If

  • You've built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You're equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You're energized by community whether it's on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You're self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in New York to support regular in-person DevRel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the NY tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus Points If You Have

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description

We are seeking a highly versatile and experienced Sales Recruiter to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with our Sales leaders to strategically attract and hire top-tier sales talent across all levels - from individual contributors to VP level.

As a key member of our Recruiting team, you’ll act as a true business partner - collaborating with leadership to define search strategies and serving as a trusted advisor to help interview teams hire effectively and efficiently. We are looking for someone who is passionate about delivering world-class candidate experiences, has a strong track record of hiring top sales professionals, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You will own full life-cycle recruiting efforts, influence strategy, and help shape how we attract and engage high-performing candidates.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States or Canada. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of highly qualified candidates for all Sales roles, partnering closely with Executive and Sales Leadership teams to ensure hiring goals are met.
  • Proactively source, identify and engage top-performing talent across global markets.
  • Conduct thorough candidate outreach and screening across multiple channels, effectively communicating role details while continuously assessing candidate fit.
  • Design and coordinate customized interview processes that align with Toptal’s high hiring bar and role specific requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, guiding them through each stage of the interview process and ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Communicate effectively and consistently with internal teams via Slack and Zoom.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal through virtual introductions and Zoom coffees with colleagues.
  • Review team playbooks, processes, and best practices to build a solid foundation for success.
  • Dive into our Applicant Tracking System, exploring its full functionality along with the tools and systems we use daily.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Gain a clear understanding of our success criteria and begin shaping your hiring strategy.
  • Review Recruiter call recordings to understand our approach and develop your Toptal pitch.
  • Start sourcing for our sales roles while building strong relationships with Hiring Managers to align on needs and expectations.
  • Begin guiding candidates through the recruitment process - from initial outreach to offer acceptance.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Have successfully hired your first candidate.
  • Fully own the recruitment lifecycle - from sourcing to offer acceptance, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Contribute direct feedback and insights to support continuous team and process improvement.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Build strong, scalable candidate pipelines to support rapid hiring for high-impact sales roles.
  • Develop deep relationships with key stakeholders across the sales function, acting as a trusted business partner to support their growth and success.
  • Coach and support interviewers to strengthen evaluation practices and elevate the overall candidate experience.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in sales recruiting, confidently guiding decision-making and answering questions across all stages of the sales hiring lifecycle.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives that improve our sales recruiting function - whether optimizing processes, enhancing tools, or driving innovation to help us attract top-tier sales talent at scale.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 5+ years of proven success in recruitment, with at least part of that experience in-house.
  • Minimum of 3 years of sales recruiting experience, with a focus on hiring high-performing, enterprise-level sales talent.
  • Experience recruiting from professional services environments, particularly candidates with a track record in enterprise-level, complex solution selling.
  • Experience hiring for roles that require P&L ownership and a strong understanding of business operations.
  • Experience partnering with Hiring Managers to strategically guide them through the end-to-end recruiting process for sales roles.
  • You bring a team-first mindset - you’re humble, curious, adaptable, and always willing to pitch in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • You’re a proactive talent hunter; you don’t wait for candidates to come to you.
  • You have a strong ability to recognize exceptional talent and assess whether candidates will thrive in both the role and the company as it scales.
  • You extend offers with confidence, knowing you’ve built trust and alignment throughout the process.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, your candidate pipelines are clean, your communications are timely, and no loop is ever left open.
  • A compelling storyteller - you know how to excite sales candidates and clearly communicate Toptal’s value proposition.
  • Open to feedback and focused on continuous improvement, both individually and as a team.
  • You prioritize by impact and operate with focus and attention in a fast-moving, rapidly-scaling tech environment where quality and speed are both essential.
  • Able to work independently and effectively in a remote, fast-paced setting.
  • A sharp eye for the traits that make someone an outstanding contributor on a global, remote sales team.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills - you deliver a high-touch, high-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

This position receives a base salary and is also eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

Compensation

Additional Information

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join Wpromote’s Technology team and help shape Polaris IQ, our marketing intelligence platform that gives clients more intelligent investment decisions and actions to grow their brand and their bottomline, with solutions across brand health, audience, creative, media, and measurement.

You’ll own multiple applications within Polaris IQ and lead the development & design group responsible for delivering the roadmap across those areas, building solutions that serve both Wpromote’s marketing experts and our clients. Sitting at the intersection of digital marketing, client delivery, and technology, you’ll work closely with our marketing services teams, clients, Engineering, Design, and other partners to understand how marketers work, identify opportunities, and turn them into clear product decisions and requirements.

The ideal candidate brings curiosity, strong judgment, and an innovative mindset to how technology, data, and AI can improve the way marketers work. You’re comfortable navigating competing priorities, using research and data to make decisions, and independently moving work forward. You understand how a digital marketing agency operates and the work our teams do for clients. For someone with digital agency experience, this role could be a great opportunity to apply that knowledge while taking the next step into Product.

You Will Be

  • Owning multiple applications within Polaris IQ, leading the squad responsible for delivering your roadmap, and contributing to the broader Wpromote Product roadmap

  • Conducting user research, analyzing market and product data, and developing clear use cases and recommendations to evaluate and prioritize opportunities

  • Translating user and business needs into requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, and prioritized work for Engineering and Design

  • Partnering across Engineering, Design, R&D, Product Marketing, Sales, and Client Services to deliver, launch, and drive adoption of valuable and reliable product experiences

  • Representing Polaris IQ in client conversations, sales demos, internal meetings, and cross-functional planning

  • Using product usage, adoption, feedback, and business performance data to evaluate success and guide future decisions

  • Triaging product questions and issues, identify patterns, and escalate bugs, risks, and opportunities for improvement

You Must Have

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, marketing technology, or a digital agency, with a strong understanding of how agency teams deliver marketing services for clients

  • Experience translating user or business needs into product requirements, priorities, workflows, or deliverables

  • Experience working with technical and cross-functional teams to move initiatives from idea through execution

  • Strong communication, facilitation, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to create alignment and make informed recommendations

  • Ability to independently manage ambiguity and competing priorities, make sound decisions, and take ownership without extensive oversight

  • Curiosity about marketing technology, data, AI, and emerging ways to improve how marketing teams work

Nice to Have

  • Product management, product operations, or software development experience, particularly in SaaS or marketing technology

  • Hands-on experience in paid search, paid social, programmatic, SEO, content, creative, analytics, measurement, or another digital marketing discipline

  • Experience working with marketing data, APIs, integrations, dashboards, reporting, SQL, BigQuery, or product analytics tools

  • Experience with Jira and Agile/Scrum practices

  • Experience supporting client-facing demos, training, enablement, launches, proposals, or go-to-market initiatives

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $110,000 - $135,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

Supabase is the backend of choice for a growing wave of AI-native builders, and we're deepening structured partnerships with the platforms they build on top of — Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable. These partners' teams are talking to thousands of developers and agents who need exactly what we build—a full backend platform with Postgres at the core—without the vendor lock-in. This is an opportunity to get Supabase in front of the right partner SAs and make us the default recommendation for a modern, AI-ready backend.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Platform Solutions Architect to join our Success Team and help embed Supabase into the Solutions and Engineering communities with AI Builders.

You’ll work closely with Partner Solutions Architects and Partner Engineers at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, helping us proactively identify builder problems where Supabase is the right solution and closing the gap between partner intent and real developer outcomes. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions of AI-native apps and agents.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

In this role, you’ll focus on three core pillars:

Technical Evangelism & Education

  • Build deep relationships with Technical counterparts at Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable, focusing initially on defined use cases and agent/app-migration motions.

  • Develop and deliver technical workshops, training materials, and enablement content to give partner SAs the fluency to position Supabase.

  • Create demos, integration guides, and reference architectures that make Supabase’s fit with Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable immediately legible.

  • Partner with SAs at these companies on active opportunities to move deals forward and feeding technical pipeline intelligence back to the alliance lead.

Technical Support & Enablement

  • Resolve blockers for partner SAs working on Supabase implementations to maintain their credibility with the builders they support.

  • Troubleshoot complex integration scenarios and turn solutions into reusable assets.

  • Maintain a close feedback loop with Supabase product and engineering teams to ensure technical guidance reflects the latest platform capabilities.

  • Measure success through co-sell opportunities sourced, influenced deals, and SA enablement metrics across the Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable partnerships.

Content Creation & Thought Leadership

  • Write technical blog posts and case studies that demonstrate real-world Supabase implementations built on Anthropic, OpenAI, Vercel, and Lovable.

  • Represent Supabase at conferences, meetups, and partner-sponsored events (e.g. Anthropic and OpenAI dev days, Vercel Ship, Lovable community events).

  • Develop video content and interactive learning experiences to reduce the "time-to-fluency" for partner SAs.

  • Understand how partner SAs at AI builder platforms are incentivized, how they make recommendations, and how the partner ecosystem influences developer decisions.

  • Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences, explaining complex concepts with ease.

  • Have a strong technical foundation in PostgreSQL, APIs, and modern development frameworks like React and Next.js, plus fluency with AI/agent tooling (LLM APIs, MCP, agent frameworks).

  • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly to build a playbook from scratch.

  • Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers building the next generation of AI-native products.

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description

We are seeking a highly versatile and experienced Sales Recruiter to join our dynamic team. In this role, you’ll partner closely with our Sales leaders to strategically attract and hire top-tier sales talent across all levels - from individual contributors to VP level.

As a key member of our Recruiting team, you’ll act as a true business partner - collaborating with leadership to define search strategies and serving as a trusted advisor to help interview teams hire effectively and efficiently. We are looking for someone who is passionate about delivering world-class candidate experiences, has a strong track record of hiring top sales professionals, and thrives in a collaborative environment. You will own full life-cycle recruiting efforts, influence strategy, and help shape how we attract and engage high-performing candidates.

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States or Canada. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of highly qualified candidates for all Sales roles, partnering closely with Executive and Sales Leadership teams to ensure hiring goals are met.
  • Proactively source, identify and engage top-performing talent across global markets.
  • Conduct thorough candidate outreach and screening across multiple channels, effectively communicating role details while continuously assessing candidate fit.
  • Design and coordinate customized interview processes that align with Toptal’s high hiring bar and role specific requirements.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for candidates, guiding them through each stage of the interview process and ensuring an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Communicate effectively and consistently with internal teams via Slack and Zoom.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal through virtual introductions and Zoom coffees with colleagues.
  • Review team playbooks, processes, and best practices to build a solid foundation for success.
  • Dive into our Applicant Tracking System, exploring its full functionality along with the tools and systems we use daily.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Gain a clear understanding of our success criteria and begin shaping your hiring strategy.
  • Review Recruiter call recordings to understand our approach and develop your Toptal pitch.
  • Start sourcing for our sales roles while building strong relationships with Hiring Managers to align on needs and expectations.
  • Begin guiding candidates through the recruitment process - from initial outreach to offer acceptance.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Have successfully hired your first candidate.
  • Fully own the recruitment lifecycle - from sourcing to offer acceptance, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Contribute direct feedback and insights to support continuous team and process improvement.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Build strong, scalable candidate pipelines to support rapid hiring for high-impact sales roles.
  • Develop deep relationships with key stakeholders across the sales function, acting as a trusted business partner to support their growth and success.
  • Coach and support interviewers to strengthen evaluation practices and elevate the overall candidate experience.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in sales recruiting, confidently guiding decision-making and answering questions across all stages of the sales hiring lifecycle.
  • Lead or contribute to strategic initiatives that improve our sales recruiting function - whether optimizing processes, enhancing tools, or driving innovation to help us attract top-tier sales talent at scale.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 5+ years of proven success in recruitment, with at least part of that experience in-house.
  • Minimum of 3 years of sales recruiting experience, with a focus on hiring high-performing, enterprise-level sales talent.
  • Experience recruiting from professional services environments, particularly candidates with a track record in enterprise-level, complex solution selling.
  • Experience hiring for roles that require P&L ownership and a strong understanding of business operations.
  • Experience partnering with Hiring Managers to strategically guide them through the end-to-end recruiting process for sales roles.
  • You bring a team-first mindset - you’re humble, curious, adaptable, and always willing to pitch in wherever needed to help the team succeed.
  • You’re a proactive talent hunter; you don’t wait for candidates to come to you.
  • You have a strong ability to recognize exceptional talent and assess whether candidates will thrive in both the role and the company as it scales.
  • You extend offers with confidence, knowing you’ve built trust and alignment throughout the process.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, your candidate pipelines are clean, your communications are timely, and no loop is ever left open.
  • A compelling storyteller - you know how to excite sales candidates and clearly communicate Toptal’s value proposition.
  • Open to feedback and focused on continuous improvement, both individually and as a team.
  • You prioritize by impact and operate with focus and attention in a fast-moving, rapidly-scaling tech environment where quality and speed are both essential.
  • Able to work independently and effectively in a remote, fast-paced setting.
  • A sharp eye for the traits that make someone an outstanding contributor on a global, remote sales team.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills - you deliver a high-touch, high-quality experience for candidates and hiring managers alike.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

We're seeking a Paid Search Manager to support strategy and execution across enterprise and mid-market accounts within Wpromote's growing B2B practice. This individual contributor (IC) role will partner with senior team members to drive performance through thoughtful campaign management, optimization, and cross-functional collaboration.

The ideal candidate has experience managing paid search campaigns within an agency environment and enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll help manage search initiatives across multiple campaigns, products, and audiences while partnering with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, and other channel teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

You Will Be

  • Serving as a trusted strategic partner to enterprise B2B clients by leading paid search strategy, performance optimization, and ongoing business planning across complex performance marketing programs
  • Owning both strategy and execution by developing campaign architecture, optimization plans, testing roadmaps, and operational improvements that drive measurable business results
  • Managing sophisticated paid search account structures across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, SA360, and other relevant paid search platforms
  • Driving strategic planning, forecasting, budget management, testing initiatives, and performance optimization aligned with client business goals
  • Translating campaign performance and business insights into clear, actionable recommendations for client stakeholders
  • Partnering closely with Client Strategy, Analytics, Creative, SEO, and other channel teams to develop integrated marketing strategies
  • Identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies, audience expansion, and performance innovation across client programs
  • Maintaining strong campaign health through proactive monitoring, QA processes, and optimization best practices
  • Participating in client meetings, performance reviews, and presentations while building strong client relationships
  • Staying current on search platform updates, AI-driven search innovations, automation capabilities, and industry best practices

You Must Have

  • 1.5-3 years of experience managing paid search campaigns within an agency environment
  • Experience supporting B2B paid search programs across enterprise or mid-market clients preferred
  • Experience managing campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads; familiarity with Search Ads 360 (SA360) is a plus
  • Working knowledge of campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding strategies, automation, and conversion optimization
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using GA4 and reporting platforms to evaluate performance and identify optimization opportunities
  • Experience interpreting campaign data and communicating recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with experience participating in client-facing conversations
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across several client accounts
  • Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace and Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting SaaS, fintech, adtech, and other B2B technology organizations preferred
  • Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot, or other CRM integrations for lead generation measurement
  • Experience managing offline conversion tracking and lead quality optimization
  • Familiarity with first-party audience strategies, CRM integrations, and advanced attribution methodologies
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools and automation to improve campaign efficiency and performance

What We Offer

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $74,000 - $90,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits .

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.

#LI-CK

#LI-Remote

Compensation

Additional Information

Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace.

Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote.

This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS.

jobs.jobDescription:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer, AI Agent Voice Experience to help build the next generation of AI-powered voice systems for the contact center. In this role, you will work at the intersection of speech, language, and real-time production systems, improving how AI listens, understands, reasons, empathizes, and responds in live customer conversations.

You will develop and improve machine learning systems that power voice experiences end to end, including automatic speech recognition, turn detection, agentic workflows, voice evaluation, text to speech, speech-to-speech models, and production optimization. You will partner closely with applied researchers, product managers, designers, forward deployed engineers, and platform engineers to ensure model and system improvements translate into measurable customer and business impact.

This role is ideal for someone who is excited by both model quality and production reality: designing rigorous evaluation frameworks, analyzing failure modes, improving latency and robustness, elevating caller interaction experience, and shipping systems that perform reliably at scale in real-time voice environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning systems that power real-time voice experiences, including speech to text turn detection, text to speech, speech to speech, reasoning and structured insight generation.
  • Improve the quality of voice AI systems through error analysis, data curation, metric design, benchmarking, and iterative model improvement, with a strong focus on real-world performance.
  • Build evaluation frameworks for complex voice and agentic systems, measuring metrics such as accuracy, robustness, latency, faithfulness, naturalness, professionalism, task completion, and cost.
  • Diagnose and mitigate failure modes across the voice stack, including transcription errors, hallucinations, tool misuse, prompt brittleness, context drift, and multi-step reasoning breakdowns.
  • Design, implement, and optimize low-latency ML systems that deliver delightful caller experience (e.g., backchanneling, focusing on foreground speaker, interpreting caller’s emotions, responding with empathy).
  • Partner with platform and backend engineers to productionize real-time inference, streaming pipelines, quality monitoring, and continuous model iteration.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, frontend, and backend teams to integrate voice intelligence seamlessly into Cresta’s platform.
  • Mentor engineers, contribute to technical strategy, and help shape the roadmap for Cresta’s voice AI systems.

Qualifications we value

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Machine Learning, AI, or a related field; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience building, evaluating, and deploying machine learning systems in production.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading fast-moving, highly technical teams. Strong communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional decisions and raise the engineering bar.
  • Distinctive technical vision for the future of voice AI.
  • Strong background in one or more of the following: speech recognition, speech processing, NLP, generative AI, or voice AI.
  • Deep experience with model evaluation, benchmarking, error analysis, and quality improvement for production ML systems.
  • Solid understanding of transformer-based models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and large-scale training or inference workflows.
  • Experience designing and deploying real-time ML systems with strong requirements around latency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Experience building data pipelines and tooling for experimentation, measurement, and large-scale quality analysis.
  • Ability to work across research and engineering boundaries and translate promising ideas into production-grade systems.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with ASR quality metrics such as WER and task-level evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience with RAG systems, agentic workflows, multi-step reasoning systems, or LLM-as-a-judge evaluation methods.
  • Familiarity with streaming inference, real-time voice pipelines, or media systems.
  • Experience working closely with infrastructure or platform teams on production ML deployment, observability, and reliability.
  • Experience in contact center AI, conversational intelligence, or enterprise voice products.

Perks & Benefits

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO
  • Paid parental leave
  • Retirement savings support
  • Remote work setup budget or work-from-home stipend
  • Monthly wellness and communication allowance
  • In-office meal or lunch benefits for onsite employees

Compensation

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

Salary Range: $205,000–$270,000 + Offers Equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for proactively creating and closing new business with roofing contractors. You’ll own the full sales cycle — from prospecting and cold outreach through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

You’ll act as a consultant to contractors, uncovering the challenges they face when running their businesses and showing them how Roofr can help them work more efficiently, win more jobs, and grow their businesses. You’ll build and manage your own pipeline, develop strong relationships with prospects, and create a world-class buying experience from first touch through close.

What you'll get to do:

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and outbound outreach through discovery, demo, negotiation, and close, while also working qualified inbound leads provided by Roofr to maximize every opportunity
  • Build and maintain your own pipeline through consistent outbound prospecting across phone, email, and other channels
  • Research target accounts and identify the right prospects, decision-makers, and business opportunities
  • Create personalized outreach that speaks to the unique challenges and goals of roofing contractors
  • Cold call and engage prospects to generate new conversations and qualified opportunities
  • Qualify prospects through thorough discovery, uncovering their pain points, business needs, priorities, and buying motivations
  • Conduct tailored demos that connect Roofr’s solutions to each prospect’s specific business challenges
  • Educate prospects on Roofr’s products and services and clearly communicate the value and ROI of the platform
  • Effectively manage multiple opportunities across different stages of the sales cycle and consistently follow up to move deals forward
  • Develop and execute thoughtful closing strategies to convert qualified opportunities into customers
  • Consistently achieve and exceed revenue and activity targets
  • Work independently, effectively prioritize your time, and maintain a high level of outbound activity
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, activity, and pipeline hygiene at all times
  • Become a champion for Roofr’s products and stay up to date on our evolving solutions
  • Partner with Customer Success, Partnerships, Operations, Engineering, and leadership to share customer insights and help improve the product and customer experience

What you'll bring to the role:

  • 3+ years of sales experience, with a strong track record in outbound prospecting and new customer acquisition
  • Proven experience owning a full-cycle sales process, from prospecting through close
  • Demonstrated success consistently achieving and exceeding quota
  • A true hunter mentality — you’re energized by creating opportunities, picking up the phone, and turning cold prospects into customers
  • Strong cold-calling and outbound prospecting skills, with the ability to consistently generate pipeline
  • Experience selling SaaS technology and conducting consultative product demos
  • Strong discovery skills and the ability to uncover both stated and unstated customer needs
  • A thoughtful and effective approach to objection handling, negotiation, and closing
  • Strong pipeline management skills and a disciplined approach to CRM hygiene
  • Exceptional communication, organization, and time-management skills
  • Highly self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a high-activity sales environment
  • Coachable, curious, and eager to continuously improve your sales craft
  • Enthusiasm for a fast-paced, adaptable startup environment
  • Experience working with CRMs and sales tools such as Aircall, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling to roofing contractors, construction companies, or other SMB trades
  • Experience in SaaS, particularly high-velocity, lower-ARPU subscription sales
  • Experience in a high-volume outbound sales environment
  • Experience working at an early-stage or high-growth startup
  • Existing knowledge of the roofing or construction industry
  • Experience selling into SMB or owner-operated businesses

Compensation Band: $80,000 - $90,000 + 45% variable USD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
  • RRSP/401k match
  • Generous Parental Leave policy

Perks:

  • We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!

AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users ). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

And don’t worry, a real, live human is behind every part of our process. Every application is reviewed by a real person, and you’ll always speak with real humans throughout the interview process. No bots, just good people ☺️

⚠️ Important Notice

We’ve been made aware of an individual impersonating Roofr using a fraudulent domain: roofrr.com (note the extra “r”). Our company takes the security and privacy of job applicants very seriously. We will never ask for payment, bank details, or personal financial information as part of the application process. All our legitimate job postings can be found on our official career site. Please be cautious of job offers that come from non-company email addresses, instant messaging platforms, or unsolicited calls.

To ensure your application is legitimate, please apply directly through our official careers page: https://roofr.com/careers.

If you receive any suspicious messages or have questions, reach out to us at talent@roofr.com.

Your safety and security are important to us — thank you for your vigilance!

Roofr is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity in the workplace regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the role

As Sr. Director of Global Compensation, you will lead the design, execution, and evolution of Veeam’s global compensation framework — supporting our talent acquisition goals and strengthening employee engagement in a competitive market.

Partnering with business leaders across the company, as well as colleagues in People Partnering, Talent Acquisition, HR Technology, Finance, and Legal, you will be our subject matter expert on compensation strategy — advising senior stakeholders on key initiatives and leading programs across compensation planning, benchmarking, job architecture, performance management, cost modeling, annual cycles, and M&A. This is not a caretaker role: we are looking for someone who challenges the status quo, brings AI and analytics into how compensation gets done, and rebuilds what needs rebuilding.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and implement competitive compensation practices across our global workforce, including salary structures, incentive plans, and equity programs
  • Design and administer compensation programs: annual salary reviews, short- and long-term incentives, equity refreshes, and promotions
  • Keep compensation programs compliant with internal policies and federal, state, and global regulations, and lead our readiness for pay transparency rules, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive
  • Anticipate compensation risks and pay equity gaps before they surface, and put guardrails in place to prevent them
  • Model costs and impact for new or changing programs, using AI and advanced analytics in modeling, benchmarking, and program design, and set how the team applies those tools
  • Deliver data-driven compensation guidance to executives, business leaders, and HR colleagues across every region and function
  • Partner with HR Technology to maintain job architecture and compensation programs in Workday and adjacent systems
  • Lead our participation in compensation surveys, analyzing results to assess competitiveness and meet pay equity reporting requirements
  • Make compensation concepts land — build creative, non-traditional enablement for TAPs, HRBPs, managers, and employees in formats people actually use, not just slide decks and webinars
  • Manage, mentor, and develop a lean global team of compensation professionals
  • Lead compensation workstreams during mergers and acquisitions

What you’ll bring

  • 10+ years leading compensation programs in large global technology organizations, public and private, including people management
  • Proven ability to design and implement compensation strategies for a globally dispersed workforce
  • Exceptional analytical depth — you build the models, stress-test the assumptions, and turn the output into a defensible recommendation
  • Working knowledge of AI in compensation — pay design for AI/ML and other scarce technical talent, plus hands-on use of AI tools for analytics, modeling, and reporting
  • Command of the EU Pay Transparency Directive and comparable pay equity regimes — you lead job leveling, gap reporting, and multi-country transparency readiness, not just monitor it
  • In-depth knowledge of leading global benchmark survey methodologies and practices
  • Strong judgment and attention to detail on sensitive, confidential, time-critical matters
  • Influential leadership and relationship-building skills across business and HR audiences at every level
  • Strong project management and decision-making skills; hands-on and adaptable in a fast-paced environment
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data clearly
  • Service-minded, with credibility across all levels including executive leadership
  • Self-starter who thrives both independently and on a team
  • Experience with Workday HCM and Advanced Compensation
  • Hands-on data analytics experience: compensation models, dashboards, and reporting that drive executive decisions
  • Deep knowledge of market trends, with a strong network in the compensation community
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related quantitative field; MS or MBA preferred

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. jobs.jobDescription:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Role...

Zone & Co is seeking an accomplished Director of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering teams across the Americas, overseeing our Platform Services and AI, Quote-to-Cash and ZoneProcure teams while collaborating with engineering and product counterparts in EMEA and APAC to deliver innovative solutions for our global clients. As a metrics-driven engineering leader with a mindset focused on removing friction and increasing efficiency across the engineering organization, this is a pivotal leadership role requiring a blend of strategic vision, hands-on technical expertise, and a passion for building high-performing teams. You will play a crucial role in shaping our engineering culture, driving AI strategy, technical excellence, and ensuring successful project delivery across regions. If you enjoy fast-paced, innovative environments and working with smart, humble people who want to get things done, please keep reading - Zone is the right place for you.

What you'll do...

  • Leadership & Team Development
    • Attract, maintain, lead, mentor, and inspire a diverse team of software engineers across the Americas and EMEA, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
    • Lead transforming software delivery at Zone through the agentic SDLC, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and the AI Software Factory model—pioneering next-generation product and engineering practices. We use Claude, Cursor, and Copilot and are always looking to use the best tools for the work.
    • Collaborate closely with engineering teams in EMEA and APAC to ensure alignment on technical vision, priorities, and delivery.
  • Technical Excellence
    • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of our Zone’s Platform and AI services (Zoe) leveraged across Zone’s product portfolio, our Quote-to-Cash and ZoneProcure products.
    • Provide architectural oversight and hands-on technical leadership across Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, agentic workflows, LLM/agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AgentCore), AI/ML pipelines, and managed AWS services such as AWS Bedrock, ECS, Lambda, Aurora, and DynamoDB.
    • Conduct code reviews, architecture reviews, and offer technical mentorship to maintain high engineering standards.
  • Project & Stakeholder Management
    • Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of software through effective planning and resource management.
    • Collaborate closely with Product, Professional Services, Customer Success, and other cross-functional partners to translate business needs into robust, scalable solutions.
    • Work in close partnership with product teams in EMEA and APAC to ensure alignment of product strategy and execution across regions.
    • Serve as a senior technical contact for strategic customer relationships in the region, ensuring satisfaction and partnership growth.
  • Innovation & Continuous Improvement
    • Champion the use of modern engineering practices, including AI-powered development tools, CI/CD, DevOps, automated testing.
    • Prioritize and drive remediation of technical debt and foundational architecture improvements.
    • Continuously evaluate and refine engineering processes to improve velocity, quality, and collaboration.
    • Encourage and enable R&D teams to make data-driven engineering decisions using metrics and insights to inform prioritization, quality, and process improvements.

What you'll need...

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles, including leading remote-first teams across multiple time zones.
  • Proven experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, building AI/ML pipelines, agentic workflows, LLM/agent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, DSPy), and AWS services including Bedrock, ECS, Lambda, and DynamoDB.
  • Familiarity with modern software development practices including agentic SDLC, CI/CD, DevOps, DevEx.
  • Strong understanding of APIs (REST/SOAP), data modeling, and systems integration.
  • Experience leading teams in the Americas and collaborating effectively across global regions including EMEA and APAC.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product teams across geographies.
  • Domain experience in fintech, billing, reporting, or ERP systems. Oracle NetSuite experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills and able to effectively and succinctly communicate technical concepts and tradeoffs with non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, budgets, and resources in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, strategic thinking, and decision-making skills.

The base salary range for this position is $190,000 – $250,000 + bonus + equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and education, as well as market and business considerations.

#LI-Remote

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Solace

Healthcare in the U.S. is fundamentally broken. The system is so complex that 88% of U.S. adults do not have the health literacy necessary to navigate it without help. Solace cuts through the red tape of healthcare by pairing patients with expert advocates and giving them the tools to make better decisions—and get better outcomes.

We're a Series C startup, founded in 2022 and backed by Inspired Capital, Craft Ventures, Torch Capital, Menlo Ventures, Signalfire, and IVP. Our U.S. based team is lean, mission-driven, and growing quickly.

Solace isn't a place to coast. We're here to redefine healthcare—and that demands urgency, precision, and heart. If you're looking to stretch yourself, sharpen your edge, and do the best work of your life alongside a team that cares deeply, you're in the right place. We’re intense, and we like it that way.

Read more in our Bloomberg funding announcement here.

About the Role

As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll join a spectacularly talented team of fellow engineers—but you will also be expected to independently own your product workflow from initial design requirements through deployment. You will be expected to move aggressively, and you will commit code daily, but you’ll get that rush of seeing your work in the wild with live users on a regular basis as you build a revolutionary product from scratch.

You are an experienced engineer who can identify problems and architect the highest-quality solutions. You are curious and enjoy working on ambiguous problems where the solutions are not (yet) well-defined. You take pride in your craft, have impeccable communication skills, and you absorb feedback exceptionally well. You aren’t afraid to make mistakes and learn from them. Above all, you enjoy taking ownership and are stifled by large organizations.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze product requirements and produce high-quality, production-ready code while creating a best-in-class user experience.

  • Build and maintain new user-facing features with everything from database models to UI components.

  • Be autonomous. You’ll take full ownership of your work, and you take responsibility and accountability for every last detail, every step of the way.

  • Be a collaborator. You’ll work with other engineers and cross-functional partners in product and design to build a world-class product and lead new initiatives to improve our user experience.

  • Create services and APIs to drive existing and new features for web apps.

  • Maintain the health of our systems and codebase, refactor and make improvements, and keep our systems robust and resilient.

  • Write clear specs to ensure product/code quality for stress-free deployment.

  • Drive large releases to production on a continuous deployment cadence.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Experience working in a start-up environment.

  • 5+ years of relevant experience on both frontend and backend development.

  • Strong React fundamentals and a background working with Typescript/Node.

  • An intuitive understanding of what it takes to create delightful, consumer-oriented experiences.

  • Strong communication skills that help you influence product direction and help collaborative visions come to life.

  • Extreme bias toward action and execution. You get antsy if you’re not writing code, improving the codebase, and vigilantly enhancing the systems that represent the big-thinking work.

Our Tech Stack

  • Typescript across all our applications

  • NestJS API with TypeORM

  • Postgres

  • Redis

  • React

  • Custom UI library built on shadcn

  • Tailwind

  • GCP

Applicants must be based in the United States.

Up for the Challenge?

We look forward to meeting you.

Fraudulent Recruitment Advisory: Solace Health will NEVER request bank details or offer employment without an interview. All legitimate communications come from official solace.health emails only or ashbyhq.com. Report suspicious activity to recruiting@solace.health or advocate@solace.health.
