jobs.jobDescription:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About Liftoff Security Team

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. This individual contributor role reports to the Director of Security and owns application security for GenAI, Creative GenAI, and emerging businesses. Application security is the primary focus; you will also contribute across cloud and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work.

Responsibilities

  • Establish secure software development standards and integrate security into engineering design and development.
  • Create self-service paths for engineering teams to build and deploy securely through documented review workflows, reusable tools, and secure design patterns.
  • Perform design and code reviews, threat modeling, and security assessments for GenAI, Creative GenAI, and emerging businesses, including sandbox design and isolation.
  • Partner with stakeholders across the organization to build a culture of security-minded builders.
  • Triage incoming security issues, prioritize vulnerabilities by risk, and work with engineering teams through timely remediation and verification.
  • Assess vendors and AI tools to ensure their security controls and product features support secure employee use.
  • Share the security team's on-call and incident-response rotation, including occasional off-hours response.
  • Conduct blameless post-incident reviews, document findings, and follow through on remediation.
  • Build maintainable security tools and automation, including an AI-assisted code-security triage pilot that produces actionable findings at a false-positive rate engineering will accept.
  • Partner with Detection & Response to turn application-security findings and threat models into detection improvements and response guidance.
  • Contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security as priorities change, including Accelerate and MX.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in security engineering or software engineering.
  • Excellent judgment in prioritizing security efforts using a risk-based approach.
  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to deliver security improvements and help engineers choose practical fixes.
  • Write production-quality code for security tools and automation, review pull requests, and navigate large, unfamiliar codebases.
  • Strong understanding of secure software design, application and API security, authentication and authorization, threat modeling, and code review.
  • Experience assessing cloud and infrastructure security and contributing beyond a primary application-security specialty.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex engineering systems and architecture.
  • Practical software engineering habits: testing, observability, version control, peer code review, continuous integration, and blameless postmortems.
  • Strong technical writing: design documents, proposals, runbooks, and post-incident reviews that support engineering decisions. Explain security risks and tradeoffs clearly in writing and conversation.
  • Willingness to share the security team's on-call and incident-response responsibilities, including occasional off-hours response.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with Go, Python, Clojure, or JavaScript; ability to work across languages matters more than a specific language.
  • Experience securing GenAI applications, designing sandboxes, or evaluating AI-assisted security tools and their output.
  • Experience scaling cloud security or working with high-velocity software engineering teams, mobile advertising, or other high-volume SaaS environments.

Why This Role is Exciting

  • High Visibility & Impact: Be a core member of a security team with significant influence.
  • Diverse & Challenging Projects: Engage in various domains including product security, vendor security, corporate security, and infrastructure security.
  • Security-Conscious Engineering Culture: Collaborate with engineering teams that value security and are eager to partner on initiatives.
  • Large-Scale Systems & Technical Challenges: Tackle complex security challenges across Liftoff’s infrastructure and applications.
  • Hands-On Technical work: Stay deeply involved in technical security efforts, from writing and reviewing code to architecting secure solutions.

Working at Liftoff is fast-paced, fun, and challenging, and we thrive on innovation. Come join our team and help shape the future of the mobile app ecosystem. If this role sounds interesting to you, we would love to hear from you!

Locations:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities/states and Canada: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, NYC, Seattle: $200,000 - $250,000 plus bonus
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $184,000 - $220,000 plus bonus

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice:

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. No placement fees will be paid to any firm unless such a request has been made by the Liftoff Recruiting Team and such a candidate was submitted to the Liftoff Recruiting Team via our Applicant Tracking System.

jobs.jobDescription:
The Role

We’re looking for a Paid Search Manager to join the rapidly expanding team that is the backbone of our company. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of both big and small that constantly challenges you, and with extensive experience and/or a proven track record, you could be working with some of our biggest brands. As an individual contributor, you’ll be trusted to oversee all account activity, collaborate with managers from other channels, and come up with campaign strategies for your book of clients.

You Will Be

  • Planning, developing, and implementing comprehensive paid search strategies to drive direct response and new user acquisition for your book of clients.
  • Utilizing business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow the relationship and client investments.
  • Creating and managing paid search accounts/campaigns via various paid search marketing platforms including but not limited to: Google Ads®, Microsoft Ads®, Criteo®, etc.
  • Managing Search, Shopping, Display, Remarketing, App Install and Video advertising campaigns.
  • Working with direct response advertising strategies to drive sales revenue and/or qualified leads.
  • Conducting keyword research, writing ad copy, and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs.
  • Creating and implementing campaign A/B test experiments to identify optimal campaign settings
  • Using Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to improve paid search performance and meet client goals.
  • Analyzing paid search campaign results and adjust strategy and budgets accordingly.
  • Communicating with clients regularly to discuss goals and deliver results.
  • Developing strategies across all marketing channels to improve client goals (eg. CPA, ROAS) and achieve maximum efficiency.

You Must Have

  • 1.5-3 years of experience managing paid search campaigns for multiple client portfolios within an advertising agency
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent analytical skills
  • Deep knowledge of the SEM industry and the paid search advertising model
  • Experience with keyword research tools and web analytics tools (Google Analytics), as well as how to use these tools in paid search campaigns
  • General knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO), social advertising, and web usability
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPS and chart building
  • Extremely well organized, able to balance client timelines and business needs, possibly across multiple clients
  • Work comfortably in dynamic, time-intensive environments where consistent fire drills and competing priorities are commonplace
  • An understanding of customer lifetime value and optimizing towards profits based on client margins
  • Ability to manage expectations and priorities
  • Experience presenting to senior-level client contacts
  • Agency experience preferred with managing multiple clients with monthly budgets ranging between $50,000-$500,000 per client
  • Experience with Google Suite

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience using AI and automation tools inside and outside paid search platforms to optimize results

Compensation

Additional Information

At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.

We offer:

-Remote-first culture

-Unlimited PTO

-Extended Holiday break (Winter)

-Flexible schedules

-Work from anywhere options*

-100% paid parental leave

-401(k) matching

-Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance

-Sponsored life insurance

-Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance

-Annual Class Pass credits and more!

The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $74,000 - $90,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits.

*This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions

**While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!

***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship

jobs.jobDescription:
About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As Client Success Manager, Enterprise, you’ll ensure a seamless client experience by guiding health system IT teams and end-users through the successful launch and adoption of our Enterprise clinical workflow tools. Your role is key to drive client satisfaction and end user engagement.

  • Lead clients through a successful implementation, from onboarding to product configuration and support.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align client needs with internal workflows, ensuring a smooth launch.
  • Conduct kickoff meetings and implementation calls, with a focus on scaled account management for a high-volume client base post-onboarding.
  • Develop and maintain project timelines for both clients and internal teams.
  • Provide training, user documentation, and educational resources in partnership with Marketing.
  • Serve as the internal client advocate, ensuring deadlines and requirements are met.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive product adoption.
  • Track engagement metrics and demonstrate ROI to clients through strategic positioning.
  • Coordinate with Support, Product, and Marketing teams to address client needs and resolve issues proactively.
  • Partner with Relationship Management to facilitate seamless contract renewals.

Location: Remote, United States

What We're Looking For

We're excited to meet candidates who have many of the following qualifications:

  • 4+ years of client-facing experience in the healthcare industry
  • Strong communication, customer service, and presentation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical thinking.
  • Quick learner with problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Process improvement mindset.
  • Experience managing technical implementations, such as SSO integration.

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $90,667 - $137,520 depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity.

Our total compensation package may include:

  • Base salary
  • Equity (where applicable)
  • Annual bonus or incentive compensation (where applicable)

Specific compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Benefits

In addition to competitive compensation, Doximity offers a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. Some of our offerings include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Flexible paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and learning opportunities
  • Wellness and mental health resources
  • Remote work support and home office stipend (where applicable)

Why You'll Love Working Here

At Doximity, you'll join a mission-driven company where your work has a meaningful impact on healthcare. We believe great ideas come from empowered teams, and we're committed to creating an environment where people can do their best work.

  • Make a real impact. Help build products that support over a million healthcare professionals and ultimately improve patient care.
  • Work with exceptional teammates. Collaborate with thoughtful, talented colleagues who value curiosity, humility, and continuous learning.
  • Enjoy flexibility and trust. We support flexible ways of working and empower employees with the autonomy to own their work.
  • Grow your career. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, and shape your career through mentorship and professional development.
  • Bring your authentic self. We're committed to fostering an inclusive culture where diverse perspectives are welcomed, respected, and celebrated.

Our Hiring Process & AI Tools

Doximity may use artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled tools throughout the hiring process to help improve the candidate experience and support our recruiting team. These tools may assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, general communication, interview coordination, note-taking, or summarizing interview feedback. Human recruiters and hiring managers make all hiring decisions. We are committed to using AI responsibly, transparently, and in accordance with applicable laws.

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Veeam is seeking a Senior Director, Digital Advertising to lead our global digital marketing function and drive the strategy for how paid digital media drives demand generation and pipeline growth through a buyer’s journey from awareness, consideration, and conversion.

You will lead a global team of digital experts and agency partners to develop audience-first media strategies that engage buying groups, from technical practitioners to executive decision makers. As the organization's paid digital leader, you will champion leading-edge best practices, emerging channels, and innovative media tactics to continuously improve performance and user experiences. Working cross-functionally with Campaign Management, Brand, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Analytics, MarTech and external partners, you will drive cohesive, data-driven digital programs that scale globally and deliver measurable business impact across Veeam segments and solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead digital media strategy by integrating best-in-class practices, innovation, and data-driven optimization to increase pipeline contribution across digital tactics.
  • Cultivate a growth culture that empowers a high-performing global team through continuous development and accountability.
  • Own global digital media investment strategy optimizing across channels to maximize pipeline and revenue impact.
  • Collaborate across global marketing functions and agency partners to scale integrated digital programs that accelerate demand generation and pipeline growth.
  • Partner with Analytics to implement global measurement and reporting frameworks that accelerate optimization and demonstrate business impact
  • Partner with MarTech teams to optimize advertising platforms, audience infrastructure, measurement capabilities, and data integration strategies.
  • Lead the partnership with key agency partners, ensuring agile execution and continuous strategic collaboration
  • Build strategic partnerships with key media and technology providers including Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Microsoft, and emerging partners.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive digital media experience, including 5+ years in leadership roles
  • Direct experience managing agency-of-record relationships, with demonstrated ownership of strategic planning and day-to-day execution
  • Proven success leading global or multi-region digital marketing teams – with a focus on leading teams in global hub locations (ie: Bucharest)
  • Experience in B2B technology or SaaS, with a track record of engaging complex, multi-persona buying groups from technical practitioners to executive decision makers
  • Demonstrated ownership of digital media investment at scale ($10M+ annual paid media budget), with accountability for cross-channel optimization
  • Deep platform expertise across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, Microsoft, ChatGPT, AI paid ads including direct experience managing strategic partnerships
  • A people-first leadership philosophy, with a demonstrated track record of developing talent and building high-performing, accountable teams
  • Working fluency in modern measurement frameworks (MMM, multi-touch attribution) and pipeline/revenue reporting

#LI-TS1 #remote

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE)

$343,080—$712,440 USD

$314,490—$653,070 USD

$285,900—$593,700 USD

$248,733—$516,519 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Zone & Company Software Consulting LLC (“Zone”) is the ERP-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.

As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record-to-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real-time financial intelligence.

By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

About the Job:

Are you a strategic, results-driven marketer who loves building high-impact campaigns and turning innovative ideas into measurable business growth? Join Zone as our Demand Generation Manager and play a pivotal role in shaping how we connect with finance leaders across the US and Canada within the Oracle NetSuite ecosystem.

In this highly visible role, you'll have the opportunity to build and lead our North American demand generation strategy, develop creative and integrated marketing programs, and directly influence pipeline growth and revenue performance. Working closely with Sales, Sales Development, Product Marketing, Content, Marketing Operations, Customer Success, and strategic partners, you'll bring campaigns to life that attract, engage, and convert the right audiences.

This is an opportunity to make your mark. You'll own regional demand strategy, channel mix, budget allocation, and performance measurement while leveraging AI, automation, and data-driven insights to create smarter, more personalized campaigns and scalable marketing programs. Your successes will help shape demand generation best practices across Zone's global markets, including EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.

At Zone, we believe in striving for extraordinary results, playing as a team, creating momentum, keeping it real, and always putting the customer first. If you're energized by ownership, innovation, collaboration, and the opportunity to make a measurable impact, we'd love to meet you!

What You'll Do:

As our Demand Generation Manager, you'll own and drive the North American demand generation engine, combining strategic thinking, creativity, data, and technology to generate measurable business growth. You'll have the opportunity to shape our regional marketing strategy, build impactful campaigns, and work closely with teams across the business to turn engagement into qualified pipeline and revenue.

Drive Demand Generation Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute the North American demand generation strategy and quarterly marketing plans, aligning programs, channels, and budgets with business and revenue goals.
  • Own marketing-sourced and influenced pipeline performance, driving results across lead generation, sales opportunities, and revenue contribution.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize channel mix, improve campaign performance, and maximize marketing ROI.

Create Impactful, Integrated Campaigns

  • Plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across paid search, paid social, email, webinars, content syndication, and industry events.
  • Develop targeted programs that engage CFOs, Controllers, VPs of Finance, and finance operations leaders within the NetSuite ecosystem.
  • Lead account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives in partnership with Sales, targeting priority accounts and high-value market segments.
  • Build personalized nurture and cross-sell programs that engage prospects and customers throughout the buyer journey.

Build Strategic Partnerships & Alignment

  • Partner closely with Sales, Sales Development, Product Marketing, Content, Marketing Operations, and Customer Success to create a seamless marketing-to-sales experience.
  • Develop joint marketing initiatives with Oracle NetSuite account teams, Solution Providers, and implementation partners.
  • Collaborate with global marketing teams to share successful programs, align strategies, and scale best practices across regions.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Content to bring compelling messaging, customer stories, thought leadership, and product launches to life.

Leverage Technology, Data & Innovation

  • Embrace AI, automation, and emerging marketing technologies to improve audience targeting, personalization, lead scoring, and campaign efficiency.
  • Establish and optimize campaign measurement, attribution, and reporting to connect marketing investments to pipeline and business outcomes.
  • Use data, insights, and experimentation to continuously improve campaign performance, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity.
  • Lead A/B testing and optimization across digital campaigns, landing pages, email, and creative.

Manage Programs & Deliver Results

  • Own the North American demand generation budget, agency relationships, and marketing vendors, ensuring investments deliver measurable results.
  • Plan and execute regional field and virtual events, including trade shows, executive dinners, roadshows, and webinars.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and buyer behavior to identify new opportunities for growth.
  • Establish clear goals, manage priorities, and consistently deliver against key performance indicators (KPIs) and business objectives.
  • Ensure marketing programs follow applicable privacy, consent, and communication regulations across the US and Canada.

Be a Catalyst for Growth

  • Bring fresh ideas, challenge the status quo, and continuously look for smarter ways to scale marketing impact.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships, communicate proactively, and take ownership from strategy through execution.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, innovative, and results-oriented culture while helping shape the future of Zone's global demand generation engine.

What You'll Need:

  • 5+ years of B2B demand generation or growth marketing experience, ideally in SaaS, with a proven track record of driving pipeline growth in the US and/or Canada.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or relevant industry certifications.
  • Experience developing and executing multi-channel campaigns and account-based marketing (ABM) programs targeting senior business and finance leaders.
  • Proven ability to manage marketing budgets, measure campaign performance, and demonstrate ROI through pipeline contribution, cost per opportunity, and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation platforms (HubSpot, Marketo) and Salesforce CRM, including campaign management, lead scoring, and reporting.
  • Strong understanding of AI, automation, data-driven marketing, and campaign optimization.
  • Familiarity with North American marketing regulations, including CAN-SPAM, CASL, CCPA/CPRA, and GDPR.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, globally distributed environment, collaborating across cultures and time zones.
  • Business fluency in written and spoken English and proficiency with collaboration tools such as Slack and Zoom.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience marketing to finance and accounting audiences or within the Oracle NetSuite, ERP, or financial technology ecosystem.
  • Experience with partner co-marketing, including technology partners and solution providers.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and intent platforms such as 6sense or Bombora.
  • Experience supporting Canadian markets, including French-language considerations for Quebec, and collaborating with global teams across EMEA, APAC, and LATAM.

The base salary range for this position is $100,000 – $130,000 + bonus + equity. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s skills, qualifications, experience, and education, as well as market and business considerations.

Benefits

At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it’s the standard. We’re looking for self-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.

We ditch micro-management for high-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers

Join Our Global Mission

Zone & Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.

Employment Terms

United States

Employment with Zone is “At-Will”, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.

Non-US Jurisdictions

This position is offered as a Fixed-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

Privacy Statement and Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.jobDescription:
Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries.

At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms.

Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech?

Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI.

By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms.

Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation.

What You’ll Need

- Native or near-native fluency in Welsh

- Based in: United Kingdom, Remote

- English proficiency

- Comfortable with digital tools

- Detail-oriented and curious

Why Join Us?

Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow

Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI

Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community

About our projects:

Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI.

Depending on your skills, you might:

Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems

Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance

Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs)

Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy

Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you.

How to Apply?

Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community.

Questions?

If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.

Compensation
